title: Decouple link-frame oracle from production address/MIC enums
description: Correctness review found generate.py labels _oracle_encode_frame independent but frame_vectors imports production AddrMode and MicLength and uses their integer values to construct the canonical fields/wire. If those enum discriminants drift from spec bits, regeneration and the main consumer test drift together, especially unsigned Extended/Elided and selector-1 cases. Use literal spec-defined oracle constants (or an independent local enum) for all canonical inputs and add direct bit-position assertions in the independent consumer.
